shape_hint: A hex-less round-bodied wing nut: a cylindrical threaded boss (d2 outer, with a smaller collar d3 at the top) carrying two thin, flat, rounded wings that flare out opposite each other to a total span e and an overall height h; front view shows the two wings as a wide flat butterfly profile, top view shows the boss circle with a bar-shaped wing pair.

role_map.e_max: wing span (overall width across wings) max
role_map.m_max: height of the nut body (boss) max
role_map.m_min: height of the nut body min

notes: Governing standard DIN 315 Form D (rounded wings, 'German form'). DIN 315 also defines Form A (rectangular/American wings) and AF (forged), whose dimensions differ - do not mix. d3_max, g_min and m_min are supported by exactly 3 sources; everything else by 4-7. row_support = lowest per-column agreement in the row. KS B 1014 and ASME B18.6.9 (inch) were not verified.

A fasten.it: fasten.it/en/norms/norm/din_315 (all cols except d3; M12 h_max typo 35.5)
C Chinese-template DB (fullerfasteners +: globalfastener.com/standards/detail_202.html (not in record; one cluster with fuller)
D ssfastenersmfgr: ssfastenersmfgr.com (d2_min, e_min, h_min only; its g column mixes y/y1 -> unusable)

verification.checks_done: Live curl re-fetch (HTTP 200) of all 7 HTML sources in the record + globalfastener detail_202; PDF not used. 9 rows (M4..M24) x 12 value columns (P,d2,d3_max,e,g1,h,m max/min) x 8 page instances parsed by header (fasten.it/ita/sl transposed, ananka/ss/sm row-wise, fuller 3 tables with dk/ds/L/y/y1/k/m = d2/d3/e/g1/g2/h/m). All 108 record cells equal on every page that carries them; only deviation: fasten.it M12 h_max 35.5 vs 33.5 on 5 clusters. Clusters per column (fuller+globalfastener merged, ita=aspen): P 4, d2_max 5, d2_min 4, d3_max 3, e_max 6, e_min 4, g_max 4, g_min 3, h_max 5-6, h_min 4, m_max 4, m_min 3. No PDF counted. Sanity: max>min, d3<d2<e_min, h_min>m_max, all columns monotone M4..M24, pitch = ISO coarse.
problems: Thin columns (exactly 3 clusters, all 9 rows): d3_max (ananka, fuller/globalfastener, schrauben-lexikon), g_min (fasten.it, ananka, fuller/globalfastener), m_min (fasten.it, ananka, fuller/globalfastener). One further 'copy' finding for any of these three pairs would sink the column; no shared typos were found between A, B, C (no typos at all except fasten.it M12 h_max), so independence rests on different sites/layouts only.

Role mapping uses different symbols per source: fasten.it 'D1' (boss d2), 'g' = g1; fuller 'dk'=d2, 'ds'=d3, 'L'=e, 'y'=g1, 'y1'=g2, 'k'=h; ita 'D2','E','G','H'. Mapping was confirmed against ananka's explicit d2/d3/e/g1/g2/h/m header and by identical values - not inferred by magnitude alone. ss g column is NOT g1_min (it mixes y1 min and y min) and was not counted.

fasten.it M12 h_max = 35.5 is a typo (kept 33.5 backed by ananka, fuller, ita, schrauben-lexikon, schraube-mutter). M14 rows conflict between sources (ita 36/72 vs schraube-mutter 32.3/63.5) and stay dropped; M3 stays out.
Form D (rounded/German wings, DIN 315 07/1998) only; Form A/AF values differ. Row labels M4..M24 coarse pitch only - fine.
ita/aspen is one page and schrauben-lexikon is one German dataset (wegertseder sister not counted).

standard_full: DIN 315 (Form D, rounded/German wings; 07/1998 table values)
